The '''salesman''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who sold [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]].<ref name="MK" /> 

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> corrupt [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] attempted to escape authorities by striking the salesman and knocking him aside before stealing his [[Color/Legends|red]] speeder bike. As Thaal started the bike, he was struck in the neck by a paralyzing dart fired by [[Drikall Bessarah]], a member of the Galactic Alliance [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]].<ref name="MK" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
The salesman appeared in the [[2012]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'', written by [[Aaron Allston]].<ref name="MK" />
